title: Space Engineers 2
provenance: Reported by kevindernomade (highball-db#1061, 2026-11-07), Apple M3 Max, macOS 26.7.1, Highball 0.10.23, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r28, D3DMetal, rated 1 of 5: App Version 4.0.0.3165, the environment settings left empty. It exits at start with "No supported GPU found". The game's render log (%APPDATA%\SpaceEngineers2\Temp\Logs\*_Render12.log) shows feature level, RAM and ray tracing passing and only IsDoublePrecisionFloatShaderOps = False failing, with the device named AMD Compatibility Mode. Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: Doesn't start in one report on an M3 Max with D3DMetal: the game's GPU check rejects the adapter because it reports no double-precision shader operations, which Apple GPUs don't have. The game is Direct3D 12 only, so DXMT and DXVK are no way around it. Keen lists Intel Arc A-series failing the same check on Windows, by the report. GeForce NOW streams the Steam version.

knownIssues.symptom: Exits at start with "No supported GPU found" (M3 Max, D3DMetal, Wine 10 r28)
knownIssues.cause: the game's GPU check needs double-precision (FP64) shader operations, which D3DMetal reports as missing and Apple GPUs don't have (the game's render log, highball-db#1061). Whether the game would run if told yes isn't known
knownIssues.fix: none known. GeForce NOW streams the Steam version
